References: `<repo path>#<text in a test title>` (vitest, Playwright specs under apps/web/e2e, contract suites) or `sendo-connect:<path>#<text>` (the private repo checked out next to this one; reported unverified when absent). Checked by packages/sendo/test/integration/acceptance-map.test.ts, which writes test-results/acceptance-map-launch.json; [AM-3] checks the list against `productSpec` (relative to the parent workspace) or SENDO_PRODUCT_SPEC when set.
notes: Browser specs (apps/web/e2e) run with `pnpm --filter web test:e2e` (part of root `pnpm test:e2e`), not with vitest; their report is apps/web/test-results/e2e-report.json.

sendo-connect references run in that repo: `pnpm test:e2e` (no database) and `pnpm test:supabase` (*.supabase.test.ts, local Supabase). From this repo, connect-contract.test.ts runs the in-process contract checks when ../sendo-connect is present.
*.supabase.test.ts suites skip without local Supabase (skip summary printed by `pnpm test`) and fail under `pnpm test:supabase`.

[RLS-13] race with FLOW-H under parallel `pnpm test` (SNL-1.2): fixed in SNL-7.3 by inserting RLS-13's broadcast as `done`, so the maintenance tick of flows.supabase.test.ts never picks it up; not re-run against Supabase in SNL-7.3 (Docker kept off).
